title: Eka Robotics Reaches $1.45B Valuation for AI Model
excerpt: Eka Robotics achieves a $1.45 billion valuation due to a physical AI model powering a robotic arm that handles diverse objects.
body_html:
Eka Robotics has reached a valuation of $1.45 billion following widespread industry praise for its physical AI model.

The company has developed a robotic arm notable for its ability to pick up a wide variety of objects. Observers have highlighted the system's performance, describing its movements as smooth and human-like.
